name: je-property-transactions
description: Jersey property transaction and probate reference for 2026. Covers share-transfer land transaction tax, ordinary and higher dwelling stamp duty, borrowing, contract leases, enveloped property transaction tax and probate duty. Use for Jersey property purchases, LTT, EPTT, refinancing, first-buyer relief or estate charges. Includes transfer bands, conditional worked positions, statement duties and small-estate distinctions. Preserves statutory drafting qualifications, valuation and eligibility conditions. Annual parish rates have a separate companion. Trading and rental income, specialist reliefs and disputed applications need additional sources. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and does not certify an engagement calculation or a complete Jersey tax pack.
